applicationInfo.name: E2E Sample Workload
applicationInfo.description:
## Overview

A **small** threat model used by the Playwright suite to exercise JSON import, markdown rendering (`sanitizeHtml` + the postcss stub) and Word/docx export.

- item one
- item two

> Data is stored client-side only.

architecture.description: A single-page app served from a CDN with no backend. All state lives in browser storage.

dataflow.description: User browser GETs static assets from the CDN. There are no server-side APIs.

mitigations.content: Enforce a restrictive Content-Security-Policy on all responses.

threats.prerequisites: with a network path to the CDN
threats.threatImpact: the user's browser executes untrusted script
threats.statement: An external actor with a network path to the CDN can inject a malicious response, which leads to the user's browser executing untrusted script, resulting in reduced integrity of user data
